pr_title: Remote: Cleanup the code that determines whether the spawn should accept/upload results from/to remote cache.
pr_body:
Remote cache (and execution) for an action can be controlled with following tags:
  - `no-remote-cache`: prevent remote caching, but allow local caching
  - `no-remote-exec`: prevent remote execution, but allow remote caching
  - `no-remote`: combine no-remote-cache and no-remote-exec
  - `no-cache`: extend no-remote-cache to also prevent local caching

A combined cache is treated as remote cache, hence is disabled for actions that are tagged with `no-remote-cache` unless `--incompatible_remote_results_ignore_disk` is set in which case local component is enabled.

Fixes #13621.

issue_context.title: `no-remote` and `no-remote-cache` are affecting the disk cache
issue_context.body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

When an action is tagged with `no-remote` or `no-remote-cache`, it's not properly using the disk cache. Only with `no-cache` should it exclude the disk cache as well.

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

```shell
bazel build --disk_cache=/tmp/disk_cache -- //some/cacheable:target
bazel clean
bazel build --disk_cache=/tmp/disk_cache --modify_execution_info='.*=+no-remote-cache' -- //some/cacheable:target
```

The second build won't check the disk cache.

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

macOS 11.4

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

4.1.0, but is still broken at HEAD.
comments:
For the given repro, the second build missed the cache because the `actionKey` is changed - adding `no-remote-cache` [changes](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/0f812eb5e561cc5415d0c9931675e58dc37a5850/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/remote/RemoteExecutionService.java#L262)  field `do_not_cache` of `Action` message from `false` to `true`. I am not sure what's the expected behavior here.

However, we do expect the second build hit the disk cache if the first build has the same flag `--modify_execution_info='.*=+no-remote-cache'`. The culprit is that we doesn't upload the AC to disk cache due to the [check in the upload code](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/18c82168433719b400a705a4a0222969a7a026ba/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/remote/RemoteCache.java#L195) checked `do_not_cache` field is `true` which is obviously wrong in this case.

> For the given repro, the second build missed the cache because the `actionKey` is changed - adding `no-remote-cache` [changes](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/0f812eb5e561cc5415d0c9931675e58dc37a5850/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/remote/RemoteExecutionService.java#L262) field `do_not_cache` of `Action` message from `false` to `true`. I am not sure what's the expected behavior here.

Seems to me that `do_not_cache` shouldn't be part of the `actionKey`.



> However, we do expect the second build hit the disk cache if the first build has the same flag `--modify_execution_info='.*=+no-remote-cache'`. The culprit is that we doesn't upload the AC to disk cache due to the [check in the upload code](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/18c82168433719b400a705a4a0222969a7a026ba/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/remote/RemoteCache.java#L195) checked `do_not_cache` field is `true` which is obviously wrong in this case.

This is my main use, I'm not flipping the flag, I'm just setting it globally, and I noticed that those with `no-remote-cache` were causing the disk cache to not work.

> Seems to me that `do_not_cache` shouldn't be part of the `actionKey`.

That's defined by [REAPI](https://github.com/bazelbuild/remote-apis/blob/main/build/bazel/remote/execution/v2/remote_execution.proto#L491) used to tell remote server whether the action result should be cached. I understand that this field doesn't make sense in our case but I am not sure the correct way to handle this, considering we may combine disk cache with remote cache.

The linked PR should fix this issue.

For the combined cache, it is currently considered as remote cache i.e. if `no-remote-cache` is set, both disk and remote cache are not touched for the action. I am not sure whether this is expected so I leave it unchanged. But I would think, in this case, the disk cache should be used and leave remote cache untouched.

The description of the tags say to use `no-cache` to exclude from both disk and remote cache, and that `no-remote-cache` only applies to the `remote` cache. This is a regression from that original behavior.

> `no-remote-cache` keyword results in the action or test never being cached remotely (but it may be cached locally; it may also be executed remotely). Note: for the purposes of this tag, the disk-cache is considered a local cache, whereas the http and gRPC caches are considered remote. If a combined cache is specified (i.e. a cache with local and remote components), it's treated as a remote cache and disabled entirely.
> 
> -- https://docs.bazel.build/versions/main/be/common-definitions.html#common.tags

And other discussion backing it up:

- https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/7932#issuecomment-502789602
- https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/7932#issuecomment-510410467

Wow, I guess I missed this part, which I feel is the main issue? I feel it's wrong:
> If a combined cache is specified (i.e. a cache with local and remote components), it's treated as a remote cache and disabled entirely.

Thanks for the pointers!

Yes, for the combined cache, it seems reasonable that `no-remote-cache` only disables remote cache, the disk cache should still be enabled. Maybe I can reuse the `incompatible_remote_results_ignore_disk` flag to change the current behavior.

review_comments: `options.diskCache` is a `PathFragment`, before converting to `String` we have to check for `null`, which makes `isNullOrEmpty` less appealing.
